real_incident_replay.limitation: Real captured results replayed through the production projector; this is not an end-to-end model run.

real_model_readonly.limitations: Isolated fixture with the incident provider and copied settings/creation document. Real model and production workspace runner; authorization narrowed to read tools. Not a UI or novel-generation acceptance test.

packaged_query_smoke.scope: Frozen MCP in a new isolated app home; no user database or model invocation.
packaged_query_smoke.scope_boundary: Managed workspace Direct MCP is tested for its empty category controller; paged queries are tested only on the separately authorized readonly MCP surface. Production permissions were not changed.
packaged_query_smoke.timing_limitation: One isolated functional run under a 30-second per-process deadline; not a general startup-performance benchmark.

payload_integrity.verification: All frozen app code matches fresh source compilation, ignoring only co_filename.
payload_integrity.scope: Windows payload; Android sources match the tested snapshot but are not included in this installer.

build.packaging_method: Canonical PyInstaller payload; resumed canonical Inno script after unchanged canonical smoke passed its original deadline and full source/payload verification.
build.scope: Local unsigned Windows query-delivery, long-chapter paging, visible reasoning and draft-save recovery test installer; initial startup timeout documented; not published.

limitations: Frontend default fork run was interrupted; the default 15 second case deadline failed. A 60 second run passed 47/54 with five timeouts and two async element lookup failures. The seven failed cases were rechecked at 120 seconds per case and 10 seconds for async lookups. A save-failure fixture had a one-shot rejection followed by invalid empty success. After correcting it, the test exposed an actual autosave retry loop. That loop was fixed and the test was strengthened to check no automatic replay and explicit retry. These are diagnostic functional results, not a pass of the normal timing gate. No repository timeout setting was changed. Subsequently the same 54 cases passed together using the unchanged repository config, original 15-second deadline and default process pool, without diagnostic overrides. Initial failures remain recorded; this is not a general performance benchmark.
This is not a new 100000-word novel/cataloging acceptance run.
